decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - A schedule for all new windows, doors and architrave (and any repair works to existing) at scale 1:20 shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work has been completed and has been approved.
Condition : 6 - A sample roof tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
Condition : 7 - All external joinery shall be of painted timber.

Condition : 8 - The position, type and manner of installation of all new and relocated services and related fittings shall be specified in writing in advance of any work being carried out, and the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority must be obtained wherever these installations are to be visible or where ducts or other methods of concealment are proposed.
Condition : 9 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until there has been a photographic survey of the internal features such as fireplaces, skirting, etc., which shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Conversion from flats to single dwellinghouse and demolition of existing single storey extension, internal alterations, alteration to elevations, demolition of rear extension on ground floor level, erection of conservatory to rear and erection of new boundary fencing (Listed Building) AMENDED PLANS
